newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian actress arrested in Houston over ecstacy pills.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian actress arrested in Houston over ecstacy pills.

text.p: An Indonesian television actress who fled the country in August after being caught in posession of ecstasy pills has been arrested by U.S. authorities, an Indonesian police spokesman said on Tuesday.
"We have already found and arrested Zarima and are working together with the American police to bring her back here," said Indonesian police spokesman Brigadier-General Nursaizi.
Zarima, 24, was detained in August after police said they found 29,667 pills of the designer drug ecstasy in her home.
The actress, who had appeared in small roles in several local television serials, escaped shortly afterwards after asking if she could go home for a bath.
Nursaizi said Zarima was arrested in Houston, Texas, early on Tuesday morning by U.S. police who were working with Indonesian officers.

Nursaizi said Indonesia did not have an extradition treaty with the United States. But since Zarima's passport had been withdrawn by the Indonesian government, her entry into the United States was illegal, Nursaizi added.
"When she entered the United States her passport had already been cancelled here. It's illegal entry...that is why the American police arrested her," he told Reuters.
He gave no other details but said he expected her back in Indonesia before the end of the week. U.S. police authorities were not immediately available to comment.
However, diplomatic sources said it was unclear whether Zerima had entered the United States on a invalid visa.
